title: Convex bounds for last passage percolation with dependent identically distributed weights
summary: On the $Z^2$ lattice, vertices are assigned random weights $W(i,j)$. The point-to-point last passage percolation (LPP) time $S_{M,N+1-M}$ between $(1,1)$ and $(M,N+1-M)$ is the maximum total weight among all upward/right-oriented paths connecting the two. Point-to-line LPP time $R_N$ is the maximum of these maximal total weights over $M$. Asymptotic distributions and fluctuations of these LPP times have been studied for i.i.d. weights.
